author: Social Media
content:
A huge thank you to Kaleigh and all the team at USB Events for a fantastic teambuilding day!
We had 55 staff from offices in Glasgow & Edinburgh taking part in crazy golf, giant jenga, beat the bleep, team ski, and more! The games went down a storm with our staff and the popcorn machine was a great wee addition too.
From our initial enquiry, USB were friendly and helpful to speak with. On the day, they communicated well and were on hand at all times, even the set up was quick - we genuinely had a smooth experience from start to finish.
If we hold similar events in future, we'd definitely use USB again and would recommend them highly. Thank you once again from everyone at Gildeas Solicitors!
